hypothesis: For small bulk inputs, read all layer rows directly on GPU from mapped pinned CPU storage, avoiding GPU-ID D2H and CPU gather/H2D submission.

predeclared_scope_if_registered.reason: b1 mapped microcase slightly slower; b8/b16 improve, so leave b1 unchanged.

expected_change: Only use mapped bulk when existing policy selects bulk and token count is in range 8..16. Pipeline remains original.
Pin CPU folded table once during setup; keep the complete table on CPU, with only bounded gathered bulk output on GPU.
Feed fresh GPU IDs directly for mapped bulk; other offloaders retain their normal CPU-ID path.
One mapped gather across all 24 layers, then existing bulk per-layer handles. No lookup reuse across calls.
Synchronize the mapped read stream before return and on error so CPU table updates and tensor lifetimes remain safe.
memory: Whole 3000 MiB folded table becomes page-locked; record cpu_table_pinned_bytes and include once in offload_pinned_bytes.
Mapped bulk output capacity unchanged; zero gathered host buffer for that offloader; original pipeline and other bulk host buffers remain counted.
Raw/restore CPU tables and process RSS remain reported; temporary setup pin-copy is not hidden from process high-water reporting.
correctness: Two seeds, non-unit norms, QK normalization/gating, GQA and padding in 128-step comparisons; force mapped range in small-model bulk tests.
Direct CPU/GPU-ID tests at batch 8/16, changing IDs, host weights mutated immediately after return, cross-stream reuse and consumer-error cleanup.
No precision/arithmetic change; require exact folded-resident results.
gates: Twelve-job screen including b16; only target b8 decode can nominate gain; fixed independent confirmation, frozen-baseline comparison and full correctness/matrix/generation required before retention.
prior_attempt_relation: A0008 tested bounded mapped prefill groups and was rejected; this bulk-only proposal instead uses one all-layer read for tiny inputs. It does not combine the rejected prefill implementation.
